ValidationRule.description: Commitment Option Code is a quote-time snapshot. A later catalogue change must not alter an issued quote.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Commitment_Option_Code__c))), OR( ISBLANK(Commitment_Option_Code__c), Commitment_Option_Code__c <> PRIORVALUE(Commitment_Option_Code__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Commitment Option Code is a quote-time snapshot and cannot be changed.
